name: Jack O'Lantern

abilityDetails.Parry Non-Contact: Siper (Parry) ustalığının temassız saldırılara karşı da Stun tetiklemesini sağlar.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Plasma: Aktifken enerji hasarı verir, blok yeterliliğini %50 azaltır ve Mükemmel Blok şansını kaldırır.
abilityDetails.Cowardice: Özel saldırı hasarını belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Poison: Zamanla zehir hasarı verir ve iyileşme etkilerini %30 azaltır.

signatureAbility:
A Flame Imperishable
During the Opponent's Special Attacks, gain a non-stacking Bulwark Buff granting +[485.29 - 1,480.78] Block Proficiency.
While suffering from any Energy Damaging Passives, Jack O'Lantern Passively Regenerates +[0.06 - 0.18]% of Base Health per half second.
immunityDetails:
• Yakma Bağışıklığı 🔥
• Kontrolleri Tersine Çevirme Bağışıklığı 🧠

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Jack O'Lantern's master assassin training grants him Immunity to Reversed Controls and Incinerate effects, and allows him to trigger the Parry Mastery against non-contact attacks.
When Jack O'Lantern would land a Critical Hit, he instead inflicts an instant Incinerate dealing a burst of [4,376.4] Energy Damage.
All of Jack O'Lantern's personal Damaging effects scale with Critical Damage Rating.
Against Mutant Champions, Jack O'Lantern's Incinerate effects become Plasma effects instead.

abilitySections.title: Inflamed - Max Stacks: 15
content: For every 3 Damaging effects the Opponent is inflicted with, or Passive Damaging effects Jack O'Lantern is inflicted with, gain an Inflamed Passive for 25 seconds, granting the following:
+[153.91] Critical Damage Rating
+2% Ability Accuracy
+[222.97] Energy Resistance

While an Inflamed Passive is active, Opponent's Damaging Effects suffer 100% reduced Ability Accuracy when hitting Jack O'Lantern's Block during Special Attacks. Mutant's Damaging effects suffer an additional -5% flat Ability Accuracy per Inflamed Passive. This does not trigger against Cosmic Champions.
Inflamed Passives are paused during Special Attacks and for 5 seconds after Intercepting an attack.

abilitySections.title: Light Attacks
content: Jack O'Lantern's fourth Light Attack inflicts a non-stacking 20% Cowardice Debuff for 25 seconds.
While suffering from a Cowardice effect, Mutant Opponents are 35% less likely to activate their Special Attack 1.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: The first hit grants a +[2,750] Precision Passive for 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Pause all Precision effects on Jack during this attack.
On activation, gain 4 Inflamed Passives.
Passive Damaging effects inflicted during this Special Attack count an additional +1 towards Jack O'Lantern's next Inflamed Passive.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The final two hits each inflict 2 Incinerate and Poison Debuffs, each dealing [6,838.13] damage over 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain a non-stacking Precision Passive granting 200% of Jack O'Lantern's base Critical Rating for 15 seconds.
Gain 12 Inflamed Passives and pause them for 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - A Flame Imperishable
content: During the Opponent's Special Attacks, gain a non-stacking Bulwark Buff granting +[485.29 - 1,480.78] Block Proficiency.
While suffering from any Energy Damaging Passives, Jack O'Lantern Passively Regenerates +[0.06 - 0.18]% of Base Health per half second.
